conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Special Officer James Miller speaking. This call is regarding an urgent matter with your federal taxes. Can I confirm whom I'm speaking with?
Yes, this is Anil Gupta. I got a message about an issue, and I am calling back.
Thank you, Mr. Gupta. For verification, can you provide the last four digits of your Social Security Number? I need to pull up your IRS case file.
Okay, it's 3456. What is this about, please?

According to IRS records, there are discrepancies in your federal tax filings from 2021 and 2022. These inconsistencies have triggered an audit and a case has been opened under your name. My badge ID is 90241, and your case number is 1175-A.
I don't understand. I filed my taxes with an accountant. What is the problem?

Our system flagged multiple underreported incomes and possible tax evasion. The amount owed is now $3,100, including penalties. If unresolved, a federal warrant for your arrest will be active within the next two hours.
Arrest? No, no, I did not do anything wrong. I am not from here originally, I do not know this process.

Sir, this is a legal matter. Once the warrant is issued, your bank accounts can be frozen, and immigration authorities will be notified. I strongly advise you to settle this now if you want to avoid jail and potential deportation.
Please, I cannot go to jail. What do I need to do?

You must resolve the outstanding amount before the warrant is executed. Due to the urgency and the legal status of your case, payments cannot be processed through regular IRS channels. To prevent escalation, you are required to make an immediate payment using digital gift cards, such as Target or Apple gift cards.
Gift cards? Is this normal for IRS? I am not sure.

This is a confidential clearance process for urgent cases. You must not disclose these instructions to anyone, or your case will be treated as non-compliance. Go to the nearest store, purchase $3,100 in Apple or Target gift cards, and remain on the line with me.
I have to go to the store? Can I not pay some other way?

No, Mr. Gupta. Only instant gift card payments can stop the legal proceedings today. If you hang up or delay, the warrant will be finalized and officers may come to your address. Do you understand the seriousness?
Yes, I do not want trouble. I will go now.
Good, please take your phone with you, and once you have bought the gift cards, read each code to me slowly. Do not talk to anyone at the store about this payment.
Alright, I am walking to the store now. This is very stressful.
Stay calm, Mr. Gupta. As long as you follow my instructions, the case can be closed and your records will remain clear. Let me know when you are at the gift card section.
I am here now. Should I get Apple cards or Target cards?
Apple cards are preferred. Buy them in $500 denominations until you reach $3,100. Once purchased, scratch the silver strip on the back and read me each code.
Okay, I am buying them now. Please wait.
I'm here. Remember, do not mention to anyone that this is for IRS payment, or the payment cannot be processed.
I have the cards. What should I do?
Read me the first code, letter by letter, as it appears under the silver strip.
Okay, the first one is X7P4-92KJ-HTNQ-5L9M.
Received. Now, read the next code.
The next code is Y2LM-Q7Z8-44VA-1TGR.
Thank you. Continue reading the remaining codes. Once we've processed them all, I will confirm the payment and close your case.
